item.title: [New] Entra Hard Deletion Protection (preview): a protected user, cloud group, app or service principal cannot be permanently deleted for seven days after soft delete, and the protection can never be removed
item.description:
A destructive intruder with Global Administrator can soft delete and then hard delete break-glass accounts, Conditional Access exclusion groups or critical app registrations in minutes; a seven-day floor turns that into a recoverable event, and the audit record of enabling it is a new event to watch.

Entra · Pilot it on break-glass accounts, privileged-access groups and the service principals your SOC tooling depends on, remembering it cannot be removed; add the enable event and blocked hard-delete attempts to your Entra audit detections.

Entra · Report which users satisfy SSPR only through SMS or voice, register a second eligible method for them (or configure a supported telephony provider), and decide whether to enable 'Allow password change after secure sign-in' before February 2027.

item.title: [New] Teams meetings get granular Conditional Access through authentication contexts: preview late November 2026, GA January 2027
item.description:
Sensitive meetings (board, M&A, incident bridges) can be gated by MFA or device compliance per meeting instead of tenant-wide, and the new authentication contexts become part of the CA estate the SOC monitors.

Teams · Decide which authentication contexts Teams should be allowed to request, create them and their CA policies in report-only first, and add the new contexts to Conditional Access change monitoring.

item.title: [New] Entra passkeys on Windows: GA for GCC High and DoD slips to February 2027, Airgap clouds May 2027
item.description:
Once it reaches a tenant, users can register phishing-resistant passkeys on personal or shared Windows PCs unless the profile blocks the Windows Hello AAGUIDs; Conditional Access, not device join state, decides where they work.

Entra · Review passkey profiles that allow device-bound non-attested passkeys and block the Windows Hello AAGUIDs where passkeys on unmanaged Windows devices are not wanted.

item.title: [New] Passkey profiles: automatic migration for GCC High and DoD slips to February 2027 and for USNat/USSec to May 2027; worldwide and GCC unchanged
item.description:
Sovereign-cloud tenants that expected the passkey profile migration (and the registration-campaign retargeting) in October will not see it until 2027; synced passkeys follow passkeyType, so attestation settings decide what gets allowed.

Entra · Government-cloud tenants: keep the October change ticket open, re-date it, and opt in to passkey profiles manually if you want to choose passkeyType yourself.

item.title: [New] Entra adds risk-based CAPTCHA before an SMS or voice first-factor code is sent; rollout began mid-October and the timeline was revised 26 October
item.description:
Telephony fraud (SMS pumping) is the abuse this targets; a blocked CAPTCHA endpoint will look like a failed sign-in for frontline users who depend on SMS sign-in.

Entra · Allow the endpoints listed in the Learn page on proxies used by SMS sign-in populations, brief the help desk, and keep moving those users to passkeys.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1530957 Microsoft Teams: Threads will become the default layout for new channels created with Microsoft Graph
item.description:
Starting late November 2026, new Microsoft Teams channels created via Microsoft Graph without a specified layoutType will default to the Threads layout ("chat"). Existing channels remain unchanged. Organizations should update automation to specify "post" if Posts layout is required or test workflows for compatibility with Threads.
